params.hypothesis: Two serial ReLUs turn flat ST slope and the angina gate g=665 into a large risk term. In indicator units 3598 = relu(-2.298 + 3.098[flat slope] + 1.288 g) and 1650 = relu(-0.359 - 1.286[asymptomatic cp:4] + 1.944[thal=4] + 1.683*3598). So with flat slope, 1650 = relu(0.988 + 2.168 g) if chest pain is not asymptomatic and relu(-0.298 + 2.168 g) if it is: a flat-slope bonus of 0.99 (logit +1.42) that is withheld for asymptomatic patients (who already get +2.06 from the linear term), plus a slope-gated amplification of the gate (logit +3.1 per unit g). Without flat slope 3598 needs g > 1.78, so 1650 is almost always 0. The thal=4 flag 2011 passes through to the output.
